item.description:
Changes since v0.2.51:
- The adapter interface gains an interrupt call and a terminal typing path, both refused for Claude desktop and for terminal Claude Code, and the rule that gestures do nothing with another app in front now names supported terminal agents beside Claude. - The website's Firefox and WebKit demo test and first-run walkthrough test are documented as part of the required checks and of every site publish. - A compiled Python file and a duplicate copy of the window-tree workflow are removed from the repository, and Python cache files are now ignored; the app itself does not change. - Two written notes in the docs compare app shells for Windows and Linux and hand tracking without Apple Vision; the app itself does not change. - The usage page now names the chosen 13-month retention period, says it is not yet applied, and explains how to ask for your reports to be deleted, with a 30-day reply limit. - The usage monitor now logs a summary line on every run and raises an alert when the usage feed goes quiet, stops passing its checks, or a key cannot be read twice in a row.
